first_impression.reaction: Song lists are usually Pinterest filler, but this one says it's grouped by style with a note on how each piece plays on the aisle, and that we can hand a shortlist to a quartet. That's useful, so I'll skim. We haven't picked a country yet though, so music isn't really our problem right now.

journey.quote: Each comes with a practical note on how it plays on the aisle and who it suits, so you can hand a shortlist to a string quartet, a pianist or your celebrant.
journey.reaction: Good. Something we can forward to a musician, not just a list of names. No 'fairytale' language either.

journey.section: How long should a processional song be?
journey.quote: Live musicians can repeat a section while the wedding party walks and move to the ending as the couple reaches the front; with a recording, ask your celebrant or sound person to fade at a natural phrase rather than cutting mid-line.
journey.reaction: This is the kind of detail people actually get wrong. The awkward cut-off at a friend's wedding is exactly what we want to avoid.

journey.quote: The Canon's repeating bass line means musicians can stretch or shorten it without anyone noticing, which is why it handles a long or uneven procession so well.
journey.reaction: Finally a reason why everyone uses Canon in D, not just 'a timeless classic'.

journey.quote: The opening movement is bright and sunny,
journey.reaction: The sentence just stops on a comma. Looks unfinished, which isn't what I expect from someone I'd trust with a 250k wedding.

journey.quote: Its simple, repeating melody is easy to time
journey.reaction: Another sentence with no full stop. Twice now. Feels rushed.

journey.quote: It has a light waltz feel and a gentle wit
journey.reaction: Third one. Someone needs to proofread this before it goes live.

journey.section: Which instrumental songs work for the processional?
journey.quote: It starts quietly and builds slowly, so the musicians can time the fullest passage for your arrival.
journey.reaction: Nuvole Bianche with a build timed to the entrance. James would like this one. Bookmarking.

journey.section: What are some modern wedding processional songs?
journey.quote: Ed Sheeran's song is from his third studio album, ÷, released in 2017.
journey.reaction: The modern list is the same Perfect and A Thousand Years everyone has. Our friends would roll their eyes. Skimmed this part.

journey.section: How does a destination ceremony change your processional music?
journey.reaction: Yes. This is the bit that actually speaks to us.

journey.section: How does a destination ceremony change your processional music?
journey.quote: **Aisle length and terrain:** How long is the walk on a beach, lawn or clifftop path, and is there a step-free route for older guests?
journey.reaction: The step-free route for older guests is my grandparents worry. Glad someone thought about it.

journey.section: How does a destination ceremony change your processional music?
journey.quote: Can the venue recommend local musicians, and can they learn your pieces from sheet music or a recording?
journey.reaction: Good question, but you're handing it to us. Do you have musicians you've used before, or are we booking strangers from a venue list?

journey.section: How does a destination ceremony change your processional music?
journey.quote: Not published: most venues do not list their sound limits, power at the ceremony site or music permissions online. Your Wedded Advisor confirms the inclusions in writing before you commit.
journey.reaction: In writing before we commit is what I want to hear. Honest that venues don't publish this stuff.

journey.quote: If you are marrying overseas, [Wedded Concierge](/wonderland-concierge?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=wedding-processional-songs&utm_content=secondary) plans the venue, travel, vendors and payments, anywhere in the world.
journey.reaction: Dropped in right after Russell Dickerson, it feels bolted on. And 'anywhere in the world' is the end-to-end line every planner uses.

unanswered_questions: Roughly what do live ceremony musicians cost abroad (a quartet versus a solo guitarist), even as a From AUD range?
Does the venue or Wedded Wonderland usually supply the sound system and someone to press play, or is that an extra?
Do you have musicians you've worked with in particular destinations, or does it come down to whoever the venue recommends? (deferred business detail)
Is there a real wedding (venue, date) showing what the processional music was and how it worked outdoors? (deferred business detail)
How does Wedded Wonderland charge for coordinating vendors like musicians? (deferred business detail)

turn_offs_found.quote: If you are marrying overseas, [Wedded Concierge](/wonderland-concierge?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=wedding-processional-songs&utm_content=secondary) plans the venue, travel, vendors and payments, anywhere in the world.
turn_offs_found.why: Generic 'we do everything, everywhere' claim. Doesn't say who actually books and briefs the musicians or whether it's farmed out to strangers.

turn_offs_found.quote: The opening movement is bright and sunny,
turn_offs_found.why: Unfinished sentences (also 'Its simple, repeating melody is easy to time' and 'It has a light waltz feel and a gentle wit') make the brand look careless, which isn't premium.

would_share_with: James: the classical and instrumental sections, especially Canon in D and Nuvole Bianche, so we can start a shortlist
My parents: probably not. Maybe Dad, for the hymns if Mum wants a church element

cta_reaction.quote: When you are ready, tell us your date, your guest list and the feeling you want, and a Wedded Advisor will plan it with you as your single point of contact through [Wedded Concierge](/wonderland-concierge?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=wedding-processional-songs&utm_content=closing).
cta_reaction.why: Calm and not pushy, and 'single point of contact' is what we want. But a song list isn't why we'd hire a planner. We don't have a destination yet, and there's no real wedding or price here. I'd save the post, not enquire.

top_3_changes: Fix the unfinished sentences: 'The opening movement is bright and sunny,', 'Its simple, repeating melody is easy to time' and 'It has a light waltz feel and a gentle wit'. They make the page look careless.

Give the destination section more weight and some answers, not only questions. Tell us who books the musicians and who provides sound, and give a rough From AUD for live ceremony music (Nic to sign off).
Move or rewrite the mid-list Concierge plug ('plans the venue, travel, vendors and payments, anywhere in the world') so it sits with the destination section and says something specific about music.
